# Editing specs or the plan after submission invalidates reviews and approvals.
$ init --name demo
> for k in functional architecture stack security; do printf '# %s\n\nWritten.\n' $k > .lacarta/specs/$k.md; done
> printf 'Fine.\n' > review.md
$ phase add --title "One" --goal "Something runs"
$ review add --phase spec --type specification --verdict fail --report review.md --summary "Gaps"
$ --agent A-1 finding add --phase spec --review specification --severity medium --title "Missing error cases" --spec functional
$ status
$ spec submit functional
$ finding resolve F-1 --status fixed --note "Added section 4"
$ status
$ review add --phase spec --type specification --verdict pass --report review.md --summary "Complete"
$ spec submit functional
$ plan submit
> printf '# functional\n\nChanged.\n' > .lacarta/specs/functional.md
$ status
$ spec submit functional
$ phase add --title "Two" --goal "More"
$ plan reopen --reason "User wants a second phase"
$ phase add --title "Two" --goal "More"
$ status
$ review add --phase spec --type specification --verdict pass --report review.md --summary "Complete again"
$ status
$ finding add --phase spec --review specification --severity critical --title "No auth model" --scenario "Anyone can read invoices" --recommendation "Specify sessions"
$ status
$ answer Q-4 --choice "Stop the project"
$ status
$ spec submit functional
$ decisions
